items.category: Textbook on Anesthesia & Operation Theatre Technology
items.summary:
The textbook covers major academic and clinical areas including:

🔹 Operation Theatre Technology & Surgical Team
🔹 Applied Anatomy & Physiology
🔹 OT Design, Zones & Environment
🔹 Infection Control, Asepsis & Surgical Scrubbing
🔹 Sterilisation & CSSD
🔹 Surgical Instruments, Sutures & Needles
🔹 OT Equipment & Surgical Technology
🔹 Surgical Positioning & Patient Safety
🔹 Fundamentals of Anesthesia
🔹 Anesthesia Workstation & Breathing Systems
🔹 Airway Management & Patient Monitoring
🔹 Anesthetic Drugs & Regional Anesthesia
🔹 Preoperative, Intraoperative & Postoperative Care
🔹 PACU & OT Emergencies
🔹 CPR/BLS/ALS concepts
🔹 Common Surgical Procedures
🔹 OT Management, Occupational Safety & Legal/Ethical Aspects
